description.s: Mobile sync client. Collects locally modified items and POSTs to the desktop sync endpoint. Applies incoming items with LWW and deletions. On Android it syncs automatically at app start and 30s after the first unsynced item change; the mobile viewport Sync button triggers it manually and shows the age of the last successful sync.

isSyncClientDevice.name: isSyncClientDevice
isSyncClientDevice.description:
True on the device that acts as sync client. The desktop runs sync-server and
 holds a synced copy of this item, so it must never auto-sync with itself.

scheduleAutoSync.name: scheduleAutoSync
scheduleAutoSync.description:
Start the timer on the first unsynced change; later changes don't reset it,
 so continuous writes can't postpone a sync indefinitely.

runAutoSync.name: runAutoSync
runAutoSync.description: Automatic sync: failures are recorded in status rather than thrown.

getStatus.name: getStatus

onStatusChange.name: onStatusChange
onStatusChange.description:
Register a listener called (with no arguments) whenever sync status changes.
 @returns {Function} unsubscribe

sync.name: sync
sync.description:
Trigger a sync with the desktop server, or join the one already running.
 Throws on failure. Callable from REPL: (await api.require('sync-client')).sync()

attachBlob.name: attachBlob
attachBlob.description: Attach blob data (as base64 data URL) to an item for transit, if one exists.

acceptItem.name: acceptItem
acceptItem.description: Accept an incoming item: store its blob (if any) and return the clean item.

storeBlob.name: storeBlob
storeBlob.description: Store a transit blob without modifying the item (for defensive LWW path).

runSync.name: runSync
runSync.description: One sync round-trip: push local changes, pull and apply remote ones.
